locations.purpose: Every original MPI, OpenMP, Fortran, C, documentation and notice file remains available.

notes: The original resource ID, source lock, target, catalog and package dependency sets are retained exactly.
Source builds require explicitly declared host GCC, Make and Python commands; no host package manager action is taken.
Only a new platform make.def is generated in the build copy, following the original upstream template. No original source file is edited.
Checks require the upstream successful verification token, exact version/class/thread count, IS iteration and size identities, and DC checksum from the locked source.
The installed binaries are independently consumed with the source build environment unavailable. Loader and OpenMP runtime checks run on the actual host.
Observed timing output is retained as execution evidence without making a performance comparison.
DC is built with the upstream-documented -DIN_CORE flag. This is a separate qualified configuration; the retained default out-of-core failure is not relabeled.
usage.summary: Original NAS NPB 3.4.4 OpenMP C IS/DC native profile, classes S/W at one and two threads. DC uses its upstream-supported in-core mode.
